shadow_ms_definition: GPU timestamp interval covering the 2048x2048 shadow-map clear, opaque caster draws, and transition to fragment sampling; zero when shadows are disabled by either the BetterShading master or render-control bit 64
gpu_ms_definition: Top-to-bottom GPU timestamp interval from command-buffer start through color and overlay rendering, including simulation, shadow rendering, camera depth/Hi-Z, and visibility; excludes later diagnostic readback and capture transfers
graphics_tail_ms_definition: Interval from a vertex-stage timestamp immediately before the grass draw to a bottom-of-pipe timestamp after it; may include unfinished earlier opaque graphics work
cpu_ms_definition: Entire DrawFrame wall time including delayed completion processing, frame-fence wait, image acquisition, recording, submission, and presentation
